attBesluta.text: Been hauling tools around in my truck for work sites and my old plastic bin was leaking like a sieve after every rain. This aluminum box is built tough. The rubber seals kept everything bone dry through a storm last week. Lock works well and comes with two keys, though I'd say it's more of a deterrent than a foolproof solution if you're worried about theft. Only small gripe is the hinges feel a bit stiff out of the box, but a quick oil and they're much smoother. For the price it's a way better value than the big-box brands. Fit some bins inside and already loaded it with sockets, wrenches, and bits—stays organized on bumpy roads. Happy with it.
